name: lab
description: The notebook's domain: notebooks, experiments, append-only measurements and observations, attachments, the audit trail and exact unit conversion, saved as JSON in the app's data home.
mount: a row `- id: lab` / `name: lab` before the page rows in blend.yaml; a page injects the `lab` service

config.file: the JSON file, relative to the app's home (default lab-notebook.json)
config.store: a Store port for tests (default: one JSON file under the app's home)
config.clock: what time it is, for tests (default: the system clock)
config.newId: how ids are made, for tests (default: a random UUID suffix)
